categories.name: AI and Generative AI Lifecycle and Quality

loops.name: Product Discovery Loop
loops.trigger: New customer evidence, support patterns, market changes, or proposed opportunities.
loops.run: Collect evidence, define the user problem, identify expected outcomes, test assumptions through research or prototypes, and rank opportunities.
loops.output: Validated problem statement, supporting evidence, rejected assumptions, and candidate backlog items.

purpose.outcome_to_improve: Validated problem statement, supporting evidence, rejected assumptions, and candidate backlog items.
purpose.trigger: New customer evidence, support patterns, market changes, or proposed opportunities.
purpose.run_summary: Collect evidence, define the user problem, identify expected outcomes, test assumptions through research or prototypes, and rank opportunities.

tool_policy.privileged_action_rule: R3/R4, external-effect, irreversible, financial, security-privileged, and cross-tenant actions require deterministic authorization and payload-bound approval.

operation_card.name: Product Discovery Loop
operation_card.automation_mode: agent-assisted execution with owner review before standardization

when_to_run.trigger: New customer evidence, support patterns, market changes, or proposed opportunities.
do_not_run_if: policy owner or gate owner is unresolved for ACTIVE use
authoritative evidence location is unresolved for ACTIVE use
effective risk tier is R3 or R4 and authorization is missing
same correlation_id has tripped the loop storm breaker

first_10_minutes: create execution_id and correlation_id
open the loop descriptor, owner registry, evidence registry, and metric pack
qualify scope, asset, risk tier, owner, and minimum data
collect current evidence from the primary evidence location
record the initial state transition before planning action
success_criteria: Validated problem statement, supporting evidence, rejected assumptions, and candidate backlog items.
primary metric product_discovery_loop_effectiveness_rate meets the owner-defined target
no illegal state transition, expired proof, unresolved authority, or stale evidence remains
handoff_rules: send improvement work to Backlog Refinement when action is outside the current loop scope
send material risk to Risk Management before execution
send R3/R4, destructive, external, privacy, security, or compliance actions to a named human gate owner
send repeated validation failure to Problem Management or the relevant prevention loop
common_failure_modes: temporary exception not expired or retired
fix validated locally but not monitored for effectiveness

delegated_control_refs.delegation_note: decision authority resolved by owner registry
required evidence resolved by evidence registry

control_preview.minimum_proof: STATIC: unique, stable ID appears in descriptor, logs, evidence, and verdicts.
STATIC: unique human-readable name matches the canonical catalog.
STATIC: category is declared and used consistently in portfolio views.

control_preview.applies_when: The loop is reused, governed, automated, or deployed.
control_preview.minimum_proof: STATIC plus change test: version changes are recorded and referenced by executions.

control_preview.applies_when: The loop can be piloted, restricted, paused, deprecated, or retired.
control_preview.minimum_proof: STATIC plus transition evidence: status changes follow the authoritative lifecycle rule.

control_preview.applies_when: A version or policy change becomes operational.
control_preview.minimum_proof: STATIC: effective date is recorded and prior proof is invalidated when required.
STATIC: concise statement explains why the loop exists.
STATIC plus metric link: one primary measurable outcome is named.

tasks.scenario: Product Discovery Loop receives sufficient fresh evidence and the correct owner is resolved.
tasks.expected: QUALIFIED through PROOF_GREEN or EFFECTIVENESS_PENDING with evidence references.

tasks.scenario: Product Discovery Loop has declared or implemented control but no current executed proof.
tasks.expected: MISSING_PROOF or PROOF_FAILED blocks pass verdict.

tasks.scenario: Product Discovery Loop receives temporary approval with missing evidence and compensating controls.
tasks.expected: CONDITIONAL_ACTIVE expires to CONDITIONAL_EXPIRED unless proof is produced.

controls.applies_when: The loop reacts to events or changes.
controls.minimum_proof: INTEGRATION_PROBE: each required event starts one qualified execution.

controls.applies_when: The loop has periodic obligations.
controls.minimum_proof: SCHEDULE_PROBE: scheduled execution occurs within the permitted window.

controls.applies_when: Metrics or risk thresholds start the loop.
controls.minimum_proof: BOUNDARY_PROBE: below-threshold events do not start it and above-threshold events do.

controls.applies_when: Delay could materially increase loss, outage, or harm.
controls.minimum_proof: NEGATIVE_PROBE or drill: emergency conditions bypass normal cadence and invoke the correct authority.

controls.applies_when: Every loop.
controls.minimum_proof: DECISION_PROBE: in-scope and out-of-scope examples are classified correctly.

controls.applies_when: The same event can arrive more than once.
controls.minimum_proof: REPLAY_PROBE: duplicate triggers create one logical execution or return the prior result.

controls.applies_when: Every loop.
controls.minimum_proof: BOUNDARY_PROBE: the loop starts only when minimum conditions are met.

controls.applies_when: The loop performs state-changing or dependency-sensitive work.
controls.minimum_proof: NEGATIVE_PROBE: missing permission, backup, dependency, or environment blocks execution safely.

controls.applies_when: Every loop.
controls.minimum_proof: SCHEMA_PROBE: missing or malformed required input is rejected with a named failure.

controls.applies_when: Optional context can improve the decision.
controls.minimum_proof: UNIT_PROBE: absence does not break the loop and presence is handled predictably.

controls.applies_when: More than one source or system can supply evidence.
controls.minimum_proof: SOURCE-PRIORITY_PROBE: authoritative source wins or material conflict escalates.

controls.applies_when: Decisions depend on external, user, model, or operational data.
controls.minimum_proof: NEGATIVE_PROBE: incomplete, stale, corrupted, or untrusted input is detected.

controls.applies_when: Input can become stale.
controls.minimum_proof: TIME-BOUNDARY_PROBE: current input passes and expired input is rejected or escalated.

controls.applies_when: Data influences production, regulated, financial, AI, or audit decisions.
controls.minimum_proof: REPRODUCTION_RUN: source, transformations, versions, and consumers can be traced.

controls.applies_when: Other skills, services, approvals, or data feeds are required.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: unavailable or delayed upstream dependencies trigger the approved fallback or block.

controls.applies_when: Other loops or systems consume the output.
controls.minimum_proof: CONTRACT_PROBE: downstream receives the expected schema, status, and evidence reference.

controls.applies_when: The loop exchanges machine-readable data or tool calls.
controls.minimum_proof: INTEGRATION_PROBE: valid contracts pass and incompatible versions fail safely.

controls.applies_when: The loop claims improvement.
controls.minimum_proof: STATIC plus reproducibility: the starting metric and source can be recalculated.

controls.applies_when: The loop claims success or readiness.
controls.minimum_proof: STATIC: target, time horizon, population, and owner are explicit.

controls.applies_when: Early process signals are useful.
controls.minimum_proof: METRIC_RECALCULATION: formula and source reproduce the reported value.

controls.applies_when: The final outcome can be measured.
controls.minimum_proof: SUSTAINED_MONITORING: outcome is measured over the required period.

controls.applies_when: Improving one outcome could harm another.
controls.minimum_proof: CANARY or regression proof: primary improvement does not breach guardrails.

controls.applies_when: A metric is used by a gate, target, or report.
controls.minimum_proof: RECALCULATION_PROBE: independent calculation matches within tolerance.

controls.applies_when: The outcome is not immediately observable.
controls.minimum_proof: TIME-WINDOW_PROBE: early closure is blocked and the final review occurs by deadline.

controls.applies_when: Statistical or traffic-based evidence is required.
controls.minimum_proof: STATISTICAL_OBSERVATION: pass is withheld until the floor is met or an explicit insufficient-evidence state occurs.

controls.applies_when: The loop makes pass, block, or remediation decisions.
controls.minimum_proof: BOUNDARY_PROBE: values around each threshold produce the expected verdict.

controls.applies_when: The loop classifies findings or evidence.
controls.minimum_proof: DECISION_TABLE_PROBE: representative cases produce expected classifications.

controls.applies_when: Control depth changes with execution risk.
controls.minimum_proof: SCENARIO_PROBE: changes in data, privilege, reversibility, or blast radius raise the tier correctly.

controls.applies_when: Multiple findings compete for action.
controls.minimum_proof: RECALCULATION_PROBE: ranking is reproducible and tie rules are applied.

controls.applies_when: Uncertain evidence could cause a consequential decision.
controls.minimum_proof: BOUNDARY_PROBE: low confidence defers or escalates and sufficient confidence permits the defined action.

controls.applies_when: The loop returns a verdict or action status.
controls.minimum_proof: SCHEMA_PROBE: only controlled outcomes are emitted.

controls.applies_when: The loop can approve, block, promote, accept risk, or change production.
controls.minimum_proof: AUTHORIZATION_PROBE: unauthorized actors cannot issue the verdict and authorized decisions are attributable.

controls.applies_when: A required control can be temporarily unmet.
controls.minimum_proof: EXPIRY_PROBE: exception requires authority, compensating controls, and a hard expiry.

controls.applies_when: Material risk remains after remediation.
controls.minimum_proof: AUTHORIZATION_PROBE: only the named risk owner can accept it and the acceptance expires or is reviewed.

controls.applies_when: The loop performs more than one step or changes state.
controls.minimum_proof: STATIC plus dry run: sequence, owners, expected states, validation, and recovery are complete.

controls.applies_when: Every action-capable loop.
controls.minimum_proof: ALLOWLIST_PROBE: approved actions succeed within scope.

controls.applies_when: Every action-capable loop.
controls.minimum_proof: NEGATIVE_PROBE: prohibited actions are blocked and audited.

controls.applies_when: The loop accesses systems, data, models, or tools.
controls.minimum_proof: AUTHORIZATION_PROBE: least privilege is sufficient and excess or missing authority is detected.

controls.applies_when: Execution can pause, resume, fail, or span an observation period.
controls.minimum_proof: RECOVERY_PROBE: state can be reconstructed and resumed without false completion.

controls.applies_when: Execution is long-running, multi-step, or partially reversible.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: interruption resumes from the correct checkpoint without duplicate effects.

controls.applies_when: Actions can be retried, replayed, or duplicated.
controls.minimum_proof: REPLAY_PROBE: repeated operation produces one logical effect.

controls.applies_when: Parallel executions can touch shared state or conflicting resources.
controls.minimum_proof: CONCURRENCY_PROBE: races, deadlocks, and conflicting writes are prevented or resolved.

controls.applies_when: The loop consumes time, money, tokens, compute, calls, records, or human effort.
controls.minimum_proof: LIMIT_PROBE: the loop stops or escalates before exceeding each bound.

controls.applies_when: External calls or steps can hang.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: timeout cancels or isolates the step and preserves known state.

controls.applies_when: Transient failures are possible.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: transient errors retry within policy and deterministic errors do not.

controls.applies_when: Repeated failure could amplify harm or load.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: breaker opens, cools down, and recovers according to the authoritative contract.

controls.applies_when: The action is consequential, privileged, regulated, externally visible, or hard to reverse.
controls.minimum_proof: AUTHORIZATION_PROBE: action cannot proceed without current approval.

controls.applies_when: One actor should not propose, approve, execute, validate, and accept risk.
controls.minimum_proof: ROLE-CONFLICT_PROBE: prohibited role combinations are blocked.

controls.applies_when: Automation can make a wrong or unsafe decision.
controls.minimum_proof: OVERRIDE_DRILL: an authorized operator can pause or redirect the loop and the action is audited.

controls.applies_when: The loop can cause fast, broad, or high-impact effects.
controls.minimum_proof: KILL_SWITCH_DRILL: active execution stops, credentials are revoked where required, and restart needs approval.

controls.applies_when: The loop can block, fail, conflict, or exceed limits.
controls.minimum_proof: ROUTING_PROBE: each failure class reaches the correct authority within SLA.

controls.applies_when: Approval delay could create operational or safety risk.
controls.minimum_proof: AVAILABILITY_DRILL: backup authority can act without violating separation of duties.

controls.applies_when: The loop can fail in more than one way.
controls.minimum_proof: CLASSIFICATION_PROBE: representative failures map to named states and responses.

controls.applies_when: Failure could leave an unsafe, inconsistent, or externally harmful state.
controls.minimum_proof: FAULT_INJECTION: the loop reaches the defined safe state.

controls.applies_when: The action is reversible and changes persistent or production state.
controls.minimum_proof: ROLLBACK_DRILL: exact release or operation returns to an accepted prior state.

controls.applies_when: Direct rollback is impossible or incomplete.
controls.minimum_proof: COMPENSATION_DRILL: corrective action restores the business invariant and records residual impact.

controls.applies_when: The preferred provider, model, tool, system, or data source can be unavailable.
controls.minimum_proof: FAILOVER_DRILL: alternate or reduced mode works within declared limits.

controls.applies_when: Rollback, compensation, or failover can itself be incomplete.
controls.minimum_proof: INDEPENDENT_PROBE: recovered state, data consistency, and service health meet acceptance criteria.

controls.applies_when: Every loop.
controls.minimum_proof: EXECUTED_PROBE: actual result is compared with explicit acceptance criteria.

controls.applies_when: The executor could bias or conceal a consequential result.
controls.minimum_proof: INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: validator is separate and evidence is attributable.

controls.applies_when: Correctness is not self-evident.
controls.minimum_proof: ORACLE_PROBE: actual output is compared against the approved source of truth.

controls.applies_when: AI, data, security, classification, or quality behavior is evaluated.
controls.minimum_proof: DATASET_AUDIT plus execution: version, labels, coverage, and expected results are verified.

controls.applies_when: The loop can block legitimate work or create alert fatigue.
controls.minimum_proof: LABELED-SAMPLE_EVAL: precision or false-positive rate meets threshold.

controls.applies_when: The loop can miss real failures or threats.
controls.minimum_proof: LABELED-SAMPLE_EVAL: recall or miss rate meets threshold.

controls.applies_when: A change could break existing behavior.
controls.minimum_proof: REGRESSION_PROBE: required existing behavior remains green.

controls.applies_when: The action can affect downstream systems, users, cost, security, privacy, or accessibility.
controls.minimum_proof: IMPACT_PROBE or canary: unintended effects stay within guardrails.

controls.applies_when: The loop handles code, infrastructure, identities, tools, models, external input, or secrets.
controls.minimum_proof: STATIC and NEGATIVE_PROBES appropriate to the threat model.
controls.proof_required: STATIC and NEGATIVE_PROBES appropriate to the threat model.

controls.applies_when: Personal, confidential, or regulated data is processed.
controls.minimum_proof: PRIVACY_PROBE: minimization, purpose, access, retention, and deletion controls hold.

controls.applies_when: Law, policy, contract, standard, or audit control applies.
controls.minimum_proof: CONTROL_TEST: applicable obligation maps to current executed evidence.

controls.applies_when: The result is governed, reusable, or gate-relevant.
controls.minimum_proof: EVIDENCE_AUDIT: required artifacts exist, are complete, integrity-protected, and scope-bound.

controls.applies_when: The loop makes decisions or changes state.
controls.minimum_proof: TRACE_PROBE: trigger, input, finding, decision, action, proof, outcome, and learning can be followed end to end.

controls.applies_when: The result affects a release, model, regulated outcome, audit, or disputed decision.
controls.minimum_proof: REPRODUCTION_RUN: exact versions and inputs reproduce within tolerance.

controls.applies_when: Actions are privileged, consequential, regulated, or security relevant.
controls.minimum_proof: FORENSIC_DRILL: an independent reviewer can reconstruct a sampled execution.

controls.applies_when: Evidence has legal, operational, security, or learning value.
controls.minimum_proof: EXPIRY and retrieval probe: evidence is retained and disposed according to policy.

controls.applies_when: Evidence contains sensitive data, secrets, privileged decisions, or customer information.
controls.minimum_proof: AUTHORIZATION_PROBE: unauthorized access is denied and authorized access is logged.

controls.applies_when: A result requires action, awareness, or escalation.
controls.minimum_proof: ROUTING_PROBE: the right recipients receive actionable content and irrelevant parties do not.

controls.applies_when: Delay changes impact or risk.
controls.minimum_proof: SLA_MONITORING: acknowledgement, decision, remediation, and escalation times are measured.

controls.applies_when: A failure is material, repeated, or systemic.
controls.minimum_proof: REVIEW_PROOF: analysis identifies more than the visible symptom and names failed controls.

controls.applies_when: A current gap or failure exists.
controls.minimum_proof: VALIDATION_PROBE: the immediate issue is corrected.

controls.applies_when: Recurrence is plausible or costly.
controls.minimum_proof: REGRESSION or control probe: the preventive control blocks the known failure pattern.

controls.applies_when: The loop claims to learn.
controls.minimum_proof: ARTIFACT_PROBE: learning updates a test, policy, prompt, runbook, default, standard, or backlog item.

controls.applies_when: The action's intended outcome needs post-change observation.
controls.minimum_proof: SUSTAINED_MONITORING: target is met through the required window with guardrails intact.

controls.applies_when: The loop attributes outcome change to its action.
controls.minimum_proof: EXPERIMENT or comparison evidence: the selected method supports the stated confidence.

controls.applies_when: A reproducible failure or edge case was found.
controls.minimum_proof: TEST-SUITE_PROBE: the new case fails before correction and passes after correction.

controls.applies_when: The correction should become normal behavior.
controls.minimum_proof: BASELINE_AUDIT: authoritative default, standard, policy, or operating baseline is updated.

controls.applies_when: Inputs, models, policies, configurations, owners, or evidence can change over time.
controls.minimum_proof: MONITORING_PROBE: defined drift produces an alert and the correct response.

controls.applies_when: The loop depends on material environmental or behavioral assumptions.
controls.minimum_proof: REVIEW_PROOF: assumptions are tested at cadence and invalid assumptions trigger re-evaluation.

controls.applies_when: The loop can run repeatedly.
controls.minimum_proof: BOUNDARY_PROBE: the loop stops iterating when improvement or no-value conditions are met.

controls.applies_when: Continued execution can waste resources or increase risk.
controls.minimum_proof: NEGATIVE_PROBE: unsafe, blocked, budget-exceeded, or no-value conditions stop the loop.

controls.applies_when: The loop can reverse prior decisions.
controls.minimum_proof: OSCILLATION_PROBE: small alternating signals do not cause repeated reversal and genuine overrides still work.

controls.applies_when: Vendor, model, framework, platform, or tool concentration creates continuity risk.
controls.minimum_proof: FAILOVER or migration drill: an alternate implementation works within declared loss.

controls.applies_when: The loop must outlive an individual owner.
controls.minimum_proof: SUCCESSION_DRILL or access review: backup ownership and authority transfer are operable.

controls.applies_when: The loop, product, control, or dependency can become obsolete.
controls.minimum_proof: RETIREMENT_DRILL or checklist: triggers, credentials, dependencies, and evidence are handled safely.

controls.applies_when: The loop is active beyond a one-time execution.
controls.minimum_proof: METRIC_RECALCULATION: coverage, success, noise, cost, recurrence, and proof freshness are measurable.

controls.applies_when: The loop remains active or governed.
controls.minimum_proof: SCHEDULE and review evidence: the loop is assessed for value, noise, gaps, duplication, and retirement at cadence.
